title: Evaluating Cultural Awareness of LLMs for Haitian Creole

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating 'non-target-cultural bias' as the proportion of generated entities that do not match a target-culture reference list in a cultural entity infilling task using culturally agnostic prompts.

Generating open-ended stories conditioned on Haitian versus French entities (e.g., names, foods, musical groups), extracting salient character adjectives using an LLM, and applying z-score analysis to compare stereotypical representations.
